review.notes: Machine-drafted ladder unit (adapter-sq@8); awaiting a named native reviewer (npm run review:packet). Invented village (400 then 120 inhabitants, a school built in 2015, a small cheese factory): all figures are fiction, not facts. Check the contrast dikur/sot and the quantifiers shumica/pakica/disa; "Çelësi i fshatit" is a joke of the story. Church paragraph: needs theological review (own words only, no Scripture).

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Në mëngjes gjyshi përgatit mëngjesin për Samin dhe Luanin.
sentences.english: In the morning grandfather prepares breakfast for Sam and Luan.

sentences.text: Buka është e ngrohtë: gjyshi e pjek çdo javë.
sentences.english: The bread is warm: grandfather bakes it every week.

sentences.text: Ai shton pak kripë në vezë dhe sjell kos të trashë.
sentences.english: He adds a little salt to the eggs and brings thick yoghurt.

sentences.text: Në tavolinë ka edhe një thikë të vogël.
sentences.english: On the table there is also a small knife.

sentences.text: Pas mëngjesit Sam pastron tavolinën dhe Luani lan pjatat.
sentences.english: After breakfast Sam clears the table and Luan washes the plates.

sentences.text: Pastaj të tre dalin në rrugë.
sentences.english: Then the three of them go out into the road.

sentences.text: — Gjysh, fshati ka ndryshuar shumë, apo jo? — pyet Luan.
sentences.english: "Grandfather, the village has changed a lot, hasn't it?" asks Luan.

sentences.text: — Po, Luan. Ky është një ndryshim i madh — thotë gjyshi.
sentences.english: "Yes, Luan. This is a great change," says grandfather.

sentences.text: — Cili është ndryshimi më i madh? — pyet Sam.
sentences.english: "Which is the biggest change?" asks Sam.

sentences.text: — Rruga. Rruga solli autobusin, shkollën dhe punën. Ky është ndryshimi më i madh.
sentences.english: "The road. The road brought the bus, the school and the work. That is the biggest change."

sentences.text: — Dikur në fshat jetonin 400 banorë — thotë gjyshi. — Sot jetojnë 120.
sentences.english: "Back then 400 inhabitants lived in the village," says grandfather. "Today 120 live here."

sentences.text: — Ku shkuan njerëzit e tjerë? — pyet Sam.
sentences.english: "Where did the other people go?" asks Sam.

sentences.text: — Shumica u larguan nga fshati — përgjigjet Luan.
sentences.english: "Most of them left the village," answers Luan.

sentences.text: — Disa shkuan në Tiranë, disa shkuan jashtë shtetit.
sentences.english: "Some went to Tirana, some went abroad."

sentences.text: — Pse u larguan?
sentences.english: "Why did they leave?"

sentences.text: — Sepse këtu nuk kishte punë — thotë gjyshi.
sentences.english: "Because there was no work here," says grandfather.

sentences.text: — Dikur çdo familje kishte tokë, por toka ishte e vogël.
sentences.english: "Back then every family had land, but the land was small."

sentences.text: Bujqësia nuk jepte shumë, dhe njerëzit nuk kishin para.
sentences.english: Farming did not give much, and people had no money.

sentences.text: Djemtë dhe vajzat shkonin në qytet për të punuar.
sentences.english: The boys and girls went to the town to work.

sentences.text: Disa nuk u kthyen më.
sentences.english: Some did not come back.

sentences.text: Sot në fshat rrinë më shumë njerëz të vjetër se njerëz të rinj.
sentences.english: Today more old people than young people stay in the village.

sentences.text: Një pakicë e njerëzve të rinj mbetet këtu.
sentences.english: A minority of the young people stay here.

sentences.text: Pakica ka një punë, por shumica jo.
sentences.english: The minority have a job, but the majority do not.

sentences.text: Ata ecin pranë shkollës.
sentences.english: They walk past the school.

sentences.text: Është një ndërtesë e re, me shumë dritare.
sentences.english: It is a new building with many windows.

sentences.text: — Këtë ndërtesë e ndërtoi shteti në vitin 2015 — thotë Luan.
sentences.english: "The state built this building in 2015," says Luan.

sentences.text: — Dikur nuk kishte shkollë këtu — thotë gjyshi.
sentences.english: "Back then there was no school here," says grandfather.

sentences.text: Fëmijët shkonin në një fshat tjetër.
sentences.english: The children went to another village.

sentences.text: Rruga ishte e keqe dhe ata vinin në shtëpi vonë.
sentences.english: The road was bad and they came home late.

sentences.text: Tani ka një rrugë të re, dhe autobusi vjen çdo ditë.
sentences.english: Now there is a new road, and the bus comes every day.

sentences.text: Sot ndërtohen edhe disa shtëpi të reja.
sentences.english: Today some new houses are also being built.

sentences.text: Ndërtojnë ata që punojnë jashtë dhe vijnë këtu në verë.
sentences.english: Those who work abroad build, and they come here in summer.

sentences.text: Një banor tjetër e bën shtëpinë me duart e tij.
sentences.english: Another inhabitant makes his house with his own hands.

sentences.text: Shumica e shtëpive janë të vjetra, por disa janë të reja.
sentences.english: Most of the houses are old, but some are new.

sentences.text: Në tokën pranë rrugës një burrë punon me një makinë.
sentences.english: In the land by the road a man works with a machine.

sentences.text: — Dikur ne punonim me kalin — thotë gjyshi.
sentences.english: "Back then we worked with the horse," says grandfather.

sentences.text: — Ndërsa sot një makinë bën punën që bëjnë dhjetë njerëz.
sentences.english: "Whereas today a machine does the work that ten people do."

sentences.text: Bujqësia nuk është si dikur: sot ka më pak njerëz në tokë, por më shumë perime.
sentences.english: Farming is not what it was: today there are fewer people on the land, but more vegetables.

sentences.text: Por bujqësia mbetet puna e shumë familjeve.
sentences.english: But farming remains the work of many families.

sentences.text: — Pasuria e fshatit ishte toka — thotë gjyshi.
sentences.english: "The wealth of the village was the land," says grandfather.

sentences.text: — Sot pasuria e fshatit janë njerëzit që e duan.
sentences.english: "Today the wealth of the village is the people who love it."

sentences.text: — Populli i fshatit është i mirë, por kërkon punë — thotë Luan.
sentences.english: "The people of the village are good, but they ask for work," says Luan.

sentences.text: — Populli i këtij fshati e do tokën.
sentences.english: "The people of this village love the land."

sentences.text: Pranë rrugës ka një fabrikë të vogël.
sentences.english: Near the road there is a small factory.

sentences.text: — Çfarë bën kjo fabrikë? — pyet Sam.
sentences.english: "What does this factory make?" asks Sam.

sentences.text: — Bën djathë dhe kos — thotë Luan.
sentences.english: "It makes cheese and yoghurt," says Luan.

sentences.text: — Aty punojnë dhjetë banorë të fshatit.
sentences.english: "Ten inhabitants of the village work there."

sentences.text: — Kështu disa njerëz nuk largohen.
sentences.english: "So some people do not leave."

sentences.text: Fabrika ka bërë një gjë të mirë për fshatin.
sentences.english: The factory has done one good thing for the village.

sentences.text: Gjyshi tregon një ndërtesë tjetër: — Dikur këtu ishte një zyrë e vogël.
sentences.english: Grandfather points to another building: "Back then there was a small office here."

sentences.text: Njeriu i zyrës shkruante letra dhe mbante çelësin e fshatit.
sentences.english: The man in the office wrote letters and kept the key of the village.

sentences.text: Sot nuk ka njeri në zyrë dhe çelësi është në qytet.
sentences.english: Today there is nobody in the office and the key is in the town.

sentences.text: Sam buzëqesh: — Çelësi i fshatit! Është një histori e bukur.
sentences.english: Sam smiles: "The key of the village! That is a nice story."

sentences.text: — Shteti ka bërë shumë për fshatin — thotë Luan.
sentences.english: "The state has done a lot for the village," says Luan.

sentences.text: — Por populli ka bërë gjithashtu shumë.
sentences.english: "But the people have also done a lot."

sentences.text: Pastaj ata arrijnë te kisha.
sentences.english: Then they reach the church.

sentences.text: Kisha është e vjetër, por e bukur.
sentences.english: The church is old, but beautiful.

sentences.text: — Këtu zakonet nuk kanë ndryshuar shumë — thotë gjyshi.
sentences.english: "Here the customs have not changed much," says grandfather.

sentences.text: — Dikur çdo e diel kishte shërbim, dhe sot ka shërbim çdo javë.
sentences.english: "Back then there was a service every Sunday, and today there is a service every week."

sentences.text: Kori këndon këngët e vjetra, ndërsa pastori vjen nga qyteti.
sentences.english: The choir sings the old songs, while the pastor comes from the town.

sentences.text: — Predikimi është i shkurtër, por lutja është e gjatë — buzëqesh Luan.
sentences.english: "The sermon is short, but the prayer is long," smiles Luan.

sentences.text: — Dikur në bashkësi vinin të gjithë, të vegjël e të mëdhenj.
sentences.english: "Back then everyone came to the congregation, small and big."

sentences.text: — Sot njerëzit e rinj janë një pakicë edhe në kishë, por adhurimi mbetet.
sentences.english: "Today the young people are a minority in church too, but the worship remains."

sentences.text: Në mbledhjen e bashkësisë çdo familje sillte një dhuratë dhe një ofertë.
sentences.english: At the congregation's meeting every family brought a gift and an offering.

sentences.text: Çdo vit gjyshi dëshmon në kishë se Zoti e ruan fshatin.
sentences.english: Every year grandfather testifies in church that the Lord protects the village.

sentences.text: — Shumë gjëra ndërruan, por mëshira e Zotit nuk ndryshon — thotë ai.
sentences.english: "Many things changed, but the Lord's mercy does not change," he says.

sentences.text: Ai merr një bekim nga pastori dhe hap derën.
sentences.english: He receives a blessing from the pastor and opens the door.

sentences.text: Sam mendon për fjalët e gjyshit.
sentences.english: Sam thinks about grandfather's words.

sentences.text: Në shtëpi gjyshi ruan një libër të vjetër.
sentences.english: At home grandfather keeps an old book.

sentences.text: Aty janë emrat e njerëzve që lindën, që u martuan dhe që vdiqën në fshat.
sentences.english: There are the names of the people who were born, who married and who died in the village.

sentences.text: — Ky libër mban kujtimin e fshatit — thotë ai.
sentences.english: "This book holds the memory of the village," he says.

sentences.text: — Ky libër është pasuria ime.
sentences.english: "This book is my wealth."

sentences.text: Gjyshi tregon edhe gjëra të tjera, ndërsa Sam dëgjon dhe buzëqesh.
sentences.english: Grandfather tells other things as well, while Sam listens and smiles.

sentences.text: — Çdo fëmijë që lind shkruhet këtu.
sentences.english: "Every child that is born is written here."

sentences.text: — Çdo vdekje shkruhet këtu.
sentences.english: "Every death is written here."

sentences.text: Sam lexon disa emra dhe mendon për jetën e njerëzve.
sentences.english: Sam reads a few names and thinks about the life of the people.

sentences.text: Një grua vdiq në moshën nëntëdhjetë vjeç.
sentences.english: One woman died at the age of ninety.

sentences.text: Fëmijëria dhe rinia e tyre ishin këtu, në këtë rrugë.
sentences.english: Their childhood and youth were here, in this road.

sentences.text: Familjet rritnin fëmijët si dikur, dhe fëmijët ruanin traditën.
sentences.english: The families raised the children as in the past, and the children kept the tradition.

sentences.text: — A ka ndryshuar çdo gjë? — pyet Sam.
sentences.english: "Has everything changed?" asks Sam.

sentences.text: — Jo — thotë gjyshi. — Ndryshon rruga, ndërron puna, por fshati mbetet fshat.
sentences.english: "No," says grandfather. "The road changes, the work changes, but the village stays a village."
